cs.label: [section] Cíl předmětu a studijní výstupy:
cs.content: Seznámit studenty s odlišnostmi chovu zvířat, žijících volné přírodě všech kontinentů, v souladu s jejich životními potřebami, s legislativní úpravou vztahující se k chovu jednotlivých volně žijících druhů savců, ptáků a ryb.

en.label: [section] Aim of the course and learning outcomes:
en.content: To acquire students with patterns and differences of animal breeding in zoo in comparison with conventional animal breeding, with the requirements of animals for welfare, legislation relating to the zoo's activity.

en.label: [section] Course content:
en.content: 1.Introduction to the cours (allowance 3/3) a.Historical development of zoo and safari. Notable people who are concerned in foundation and development of zoo. Importance and function of zoo. Zoo in the Czech Republic, zoo in the world.b.Animal welfare in zoo, animal requirements for welfare in zoo. Ethological and legislative aspects associated with animal breeding in zoo, wildlife versus animal breeding in zoo.c.Reproduction of animals in zoo.2.Breeding of perissodactyles and artiodactyles (allowance 2/2)3.Breeding of elephants, rhinoceroses, hippopotamuses (allowance 1/1)4.Breeding of carnivorous animals (allowance 2/2)5.Breeding of primates (allowance 2/2)6.Breeding of birds (allowance 1/1)7.Breeding of sea animals (allowance 1/1)
